note: Per floor, as the map draws it (tools/app/footprints.py): footprint = every shape merged, gaps and holes under 5 m closed, filled in the wall colour under the rest; pockets = the gaps in it too thick for a wall, drawn as blank space 0.18 m in from the shapes; ground = those among the site's outdoor features, drawn as open ground up to them (0.3 m short of the building); walk = the walkable area cleaned of slivers and nicks under 0.6 m; rooms = rooms and stairs grown into the gap round them (up to 0.9 m) to meet their walls, by id. Rings in sheet pixels, or campus metres where `frame` is "campus" (a floor the CAD's corrections move, worked where the map draws it); nonzero: outlines one way round, holes the other. Drawing only: routing keeps the traced outline.
